story.text: 해 질 녘, 을지로 골목 낡은 호프집 간판에 불이 켜졌다. 규현이 앞장서 문을 열었다.
story.reading: hae jil nyeok, eul-ji-ro gol-mok nalg-eun ho-peu-jib gan-pan-e bul-i kyeo-jyeot-da. gyu-hyeon-i ap-jang-seo mun-eul yeol-eot-da.
story.en: As dusk fell, the lights came on over the sign of an old pub tucked away in an Euljiro alley. Kyuhyun led the way and pushed open the door.

story.text: "한국 왔으면 치맥이지, 아가씨. 이건 국룰이에요." 그가 자리에 앉으며 당당하게 메뉴판을 내밀었다.
story.reading: "han-guk wat-eu-myeon chi-maeg-i-ji, a-ga-ssi. i-geon guk-lyul-i-e-yo." geu-ga ja-ri-e anj-eu-myeo dang-dang-ha-ge me-nyu-pan-eul nae-mil-eot-da.
story.en: "If you're in Korea, it's chimaek, miss. That's just the unwritten rule." He sat down and confidently held out the menu.

story.text: 잠시 뒤 노릇노릇한 후라이드 치킨과 얼음처럼 차가운 생맥주 두 잔이 테이블 위에 놓였다.
story.reading: jam-si dwi no-reut-no-reut-han hu-ra-i-deu chi-kin-gwa eol-eum-cheo-reom cha-ga-un saeng-maek-ju du jan-i te-i-beul wi-e noh-yeot-da.
story.en: A little while later, golden-brown fried chicken and two glasses of draft beer as cold as ice were set on the table.

story.text: "자, 잔 들어요." 규현이 잔을 들며 씩 웃었다. "우리의 재회를 위하여, 건배!"
story.reading: "ja, jan deul-eo-yo." gyu-hyeon-i jan-eul deul-myeo ssik us-eot-da. "u-ri-ui jae-hoe-reul wi-ha-yeo, geon-bae!"
story.en: "Come on, raise your glass." Kyuhyun lifted his glass with a grin. "To our reunion—cheers!"

story.text: 쨍, 하고 부딪힌 잔에서 청량한 소리가 울렸다. 시원한 맥주 한 모금에 하루의 피로가 싹 풀리는 기분이었다.
story.reading: jjaeng, ha-go bu-dit-hin jan-e-seo cheong-nyang-han so-ri-ga ul-lyeot-da. si-won-han maek-ju han mo-geum-e ha-ru-ui pi-ro-ga ssak pul-li-neun gi-bun-i-eot-da.
story.en: The glasses clinked with a crisp, refreshing sound. One cool sip of beer, and it felt like the whole day's fatigue melted away.

story.text: "크으, 시원하다." 내가 감탄하자 규현이 흐뭇하게 웃으며 치킨 다리 하나를 내 접시에 놓아 주었다. "안주는 이게 진리지."
story.reading: "keu-eu, si-won-ha-da." nae-ga gam-tan-ha-ja gyu-hyeon-i heu-mut-ha-ge us-eu-myeo chi-kin da-ri ha-na-reul nae jeob-si-e noh-a ju-eot-da. "an-ju-neun i-ge jil-li-ji."
story.en: "Ahh, refreshing." As I sighed in satisfaction, Kyuhyun smiled fondly and set a chicken leg on my plate. "This right here is the real bar snack."

story.text: "오늘 같은 날은 야식도 하나 더 시켜야 되는데." 그가 눈을 반짝이며 핸드폰을 집어 들었다. "어때요, 계속 갈까요?"
story.reading: "o-neul gat-eun nal-eun ya-sik-do ha-na deo si-kyeo-ya doe-neun-de." geu-ga nun-eul ban-jjag-i-myeo haen-deu-pon-eul jib-eo deul-eot-da. "eo-ttae-yo, gye-sok gal-kka-yo?"
story.en: "A night like this really calls for one more round of late-night snacks." His eyes sparkled as he picked up his phone. "What do you say, should we keep going?"

story.text: 늦은 밤까지 이어진 수다와 웃음 속에서, 나는 이 능글맞은 친구와 함께라면 무엇을 해도 즐겁다는 걸 새삼 느꼈다.
story.reading: neuj-eun bam-kka-ji i-eo-jin su-da-wa us-eum sog-e-seo, na-neun i neung-geul-maj-eun chin-gu-wa ham-kke-ra-myeon mu-eos-eul hae-do jeul-geob-da-neun geol sae-sam neu-kkyeot-da.
story.en: In the chatter and laughter that stretched late into the night, I realized once again that anything was fun as long as I was with this smooth-talking friend of mine.

words.meaning: chicken and beer (a classic Korean combo)
words.example_en: How about chicken and beer for dinner tonight?
What should we order to go with the drinks?
Should we eat ramen as a late-night snack?

Should we order some late-night food?
